supersedes: timing_v1_protocol_draft 3109c38d (bill 20:55: one horizon N=20, one model; 2024-04+ is not an unobserved seal; exact two-state action values and label maturity required)
owner_directive: learn when to buy and when to sell; verify the decisions as post-cost won PnL
scope: one asset KODEX200, one horizon N = 20 sessions, one model (M1), two states (cash / holding), three actions (buy, sell, hold-or-wait), daily decisions, post-cost ledger vs baselines

data.raw_prices: 2da39950… raw O/C for labels and the ledger (integer won)
data.state: frozen EWMA second moment (lambda .94, pinned h_initial/h_ref) reproduced as in predict-h20-v3 for two features

conventions.decision: close i, features through close i only
conventions.execution: open i+1; buy fill O[i+1]+5, sell fill O[i+1]-5; proportional fee f = 15/100000 per side in label arithmetic; integer floor fee in the ledger
conventions.endpoint: open i+1+N = O[i+21] with the same fill conventions

state_cash.buy: pay (O[i+1]+5)(1+f) per share at open i+1; liquidation-equivalent value at the endpoint (O[i+21]-5)(1-f) per share
state_cash.wait: keep the same cash for N sessions; endpoint value = cash (yield 0)
state_cash.label_buy: y_buy(i) = 1 if (O[i+21]-5)(1-f) > (O[i+1]+5)(1+f) else 0; equivalently gross forward open-to-open return exceeds the round-trip cost c_rt(i) = (O[i+1]+5)(1+f)/((O[i+21]-5)(1-f)) - 1 evaluated on the realized path
state_cash.determined_at: open i+21 (label matures when i+21 <= training cutoff index)

state_holding.sell: receive (O[i+1]-5)(1-f) per share at open i+1 and hold cash to the endpoint
state_holding.hold: keep the share; liquidation-equivalent value at the endpoint (O[i+21]-5)(1-f) per share
state_holding.label_sell: y_sell(i) = 1 if (O[i+1]-5)(1-f) > (O[i+21]-5)(1-f), i.e. O[i+1] > O[i+21] (one exit fee is paid on either path, so the exit cost cancels; the comparison is the gross forward move)
state_holding.alternative_not_drafted: hold valued at the marked open O[i+21] without liquidation equivalence (biases toward holding by one exit cost); bill to choose

action_values_same_future_path.note: both labels are computed per share on the realized future path with the declared fill conventions; the realized ledger pays actual integer fees and may hold shorter or longer than N (see policy)

one_model_choice.drafted_M1: one L2 logistic regression (C = 1.0, standardized features from training-fold statistics) trained on y_buy; p(i) = P(y_buy = 1 | features_i)
one_model_choice.action_rule: cash: buy if p(i) > 0.5 else wait; holding: sell if p(i) < 0.5 else hold; threshold 0.5 fixed
one_model_choice.declared_approximation: the sell rule uses the net-of-round-trip label rather than the exact y_sell comparison, so it sells when the expected net 20-session return is negative; this biases toward selling by about c_rt relative to y_sell
one_model_choice.alternative_not_drafted: two heads on one feature set (buy head on y_buy, sell head on y_sell); bill said one model, so listed only

policy_and_repeated_trading.daily_re_decision: every close re-decides; a position opened at open i+1 can be sold at any later open j+1 where p(j) < 0.5 and re-entered later; each switch pays fee and tick in the ledger
policy_and_repeated_trading.holding_state_deposits: while holding, target weight 1 each day so new deposits are deployed at the next open (R1-like); while in cash, deposits accumulate idle
policy_and_repeated_trading.horizon_mismatch: labels value N-session holds; the realized policy's holding periods are emergent and will differ; the ledger measures the realized path, not the label economics
policy_and_repeated_trading.alternative_not_drafted: forced N-session hold after each buy (no sell decision before the endpoint) which matches the label economics but removes learned exits

features_at_close_i: 20-session realized standard deviation of daily log returns
frozen EWMA h_i and cell v_i
current state indicator (holding or cash) is NOT a feature: the label does not depend on it and the model is shared
feature_rules: past-only; standardization from the training fold only; fixed set, no selection

training_and_maturity.walk_forward: yearly refit, expanding window from 2003-08-01; for test year y (2015..2023) train on decisions i with i + 21 <= first session index of y (purge = 21 sessions); predictions for year y use that single fit
training_and_maturity.unmatured_labels: never enter training; decision inputs never include any label or outcome
training_and_maturity.fixed_hyperparameters: C = 1.0, max_iter 1000, lbfgs (sklearn LogisticRegression) or numpy IRLS fallback; no tuning; single fit per fold
training_and_maturity.post_hoc_validation_2024_04_onward: frozen-rule walk-forward validation on 2024-04-01 .. 2026-11-05 using the model fit on labels matured before 2024-04-01, refit yearly on 2025-01-02 and 2026-01-02 with the same rule; this window has been viewed repeatedly in earlier research and is NOT an unobserved seal
training_and_maturity.prospective_validation: from the first session after bill approval, record each day's p(i) and action before the outcome exists (append-only log with hashes); evaluate as labels mature; this is the only genuinely new validation and it starts empty

baselines_identical_mechanics.R3: MA200 in/out (buy when C > MA200, sell all when C < MA200)

evaluation.primary: post-cost ledger per fold year 2015..2023 and pooled: PnL (won), PnL % of deposits, max drawdown, exposure, number of buys/sells, fees, ticks; M1 vs R1 / R0 / R3; then the 2024-04+ frozen-rule table side by side
evaluation.secondary: label base rate per fold, accuracy, AUC (descriptive), share of days long, realized holding period distribution
evaluation.exclusions: no p-values treating days as independent; no horizon/threshold/feature/hyperparameter selection after results; no attribution of failure to overfitting without evidence; no claim of live edge

resources.fits: 9 development folds + 3 post-hoc refits = 12 fits of one logistic model

verification_required: synthetic label fixtures: hand-computed y_buy / y_sell on a few prices incl. ties and the cost boundary
purge test: a decision whose label matures after the cutoff is excluded from training; perturbing prices after the cutoff cannot change the fitted model or any decision before it
policy/ledger fixtures: buy then sell then re-buy with exact integer costs; holding-state daily deployment; cash-state idle accumulation
walk-forward fold boundaries by hand on a synthetic calendar
IRLS vs sklearn agreement on a small fixture (if sklearn used)
real selftest limited to hashes/calendar/counts; no real fit before bill's code review
deliverables: timing_v2.py (features, labels, folds, M1, policy, ledger, selftest)
post-hoc 2024-04+ artifact in the same run, clearly labelled frozen-rule validation
owner report in won vs R1 with drawdowns
open_choices_for_bill: sell label with liquidation-equivalent hold (drafted) vs marked hold
one model on y_buy with 0.5 rules (drafted) vs two heads
refit schedule inside 2024-04+ (yearly drafted) vs none
whether R3 stays as a rule baseline
